question: What is the annual retention rate of legislators who began their first term between January 1, 1917 and December 31, 1999, measured as the proportion of this cohort still in office on December 31st for each of the first 20 years following their initial term start? The results should show all 20 periods in sequence regardless of whether any legislators were retained in a particular year.

WITH cohort AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT 
        id_bioguide,
        first_term_start
    FROM (
        SELECT id_bioguide, MIN(term_start) as first_term_start
        FROM legislators_terms 
        WHERE term_number = 0
            AND term_start >= '1917-01-01'
            AND term_start <= '1999-12-31'
        GROUP BY id_bioguide
    )
),
years AS (
    SELECT 1 as year_offset UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5
    UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10
    UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12 UNION ALL SELECT 13 UNION ALL SELECT 14 UNION ALL SELECT 15
    UNION ALL SELECT 16 UNION ALL SELECT 17 UNION ALL SELECT 18 UNION ALL SELECT 19 UNION ALL SELECT 20
),
cohort_years AS (
    SELECT 
        c.id_bioguide,
        c.first_term_start,
        y.year_offset,
        CONCAT(CAST(CAST(SUBSTR(c.first_term_start, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) + y.year_offset AS VARCHAR), '-12-31') as check_date_str
    FROM cohort c
    CROSS JOIN years y
),
in_office AS (
    SELECT 
        cy.id_bioguide,
        cy.year_offset,
        cy.check_date_str,
        CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) as term_start_date,
        CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE) as term_end_date
    FROM cohort_years cy
    LEFT JOIN legislators_terms lt ON cy.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
),
retained_by_offset AS (
    SELECT 
        year_offset,
        COUNT(DISTINCT id_bioguide) as retained_count
    FROM in_office
    WHERE term_start_date <= CAST(check_date_str AS DATE) 
       AND (term_end_date > CAST(check_date_str AS DATE) OR term_end_date IS NULL)
    GROUP BY year_offset
),
total_cohort AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM cohort
),
all_years AS (
    SELECT year_offset FROM years
),
retention AS (
    SELECT 
        ay.year_offset,
        COALESCE(rbo.retained_count, 0) as retained_count,
        t.total,
        1.0 * COALESCE(rbo.retained_count, 0) / t.total as retention_rate
    FROM all_years ay
    LEFT JOIN retained_by_offset rbo ON ay.year_offset = rbo.year_offset
    CROSS JOIN total_cohort t
    ORDER BY ay.year_offset
)
SELECT year_offset, retention_rate
FROM retention
